scenarios.name: opponent-more-lands-searches-basic
scenarios.why: The opponent has two lands while Land Tax's controller has one, so the upkeep condition is true; the player chooses to search out one Forest.

scenarios.name: equal-lands-no-upkeep-trigger
scenarios.why: Both players control one land, so the opponent does not have more lands and Land Tax does not trigger.

scenarios.name: condition-false-at-resolution-searches-nothing
scenarios.why: At upkeep the opponent controls two lands to the controller's one, so the intervening-if holds at trigger time and the ability goes on the stack. The runner then removes an opposing land before resolution, so the opponent no longer controls more lands; per CR 603.4 the condition is checked again on resolution, the ability does nothing and no land is searched.
